goals.title: Achieve zero silent failures — every cron run is visible and verified
goals.why: Silent failures are the worst kind. If a cron fails and nobody knows, the system is lying about its health.
goals.progress: Health writer appears to be running, but health signal paths are inconsistent: workspace/logs/health.jsonl is stale while ~/.openclaw/logs/health.jsonl is historical. Risk of false reporting until canonical path is enforced.
goals.nextAction: Decide canonical health.jsonl location (recommend: /Users/redinside/.openclaw/workspace/logs/health.jsonl) and point writer + monitors there; keep legacy path via symlink/redirect if needed.

goals.title: Make A2A delegation log the source of truth for team activity
goals.why: If a2a-delegations.jsonl is populated and accurate, Anurag can see the team working without asking anyone.
goals.progress: a2a-delegations.jsonl is actively populated today with dispatch/result/compliance events across agents; remaining work is to ensure OPS also logs new escalations consistently.
goals.nextAction: Append OPS inner-loop escalations + replies into a2a-delegations.jsonl each cycle; add a simple daily check that the file advanced within the last 6h.

goals.title: Close all P2 tickets within SLA
goals.why: P2 tickets at 8h SLA. If they're open longer, the system is not self-healing.
goals.progress: Two P2 items remain SLA-breached and require human/action gating: TICKET-20260223-002 (DNS/Tailscale) + TICKET-20260221-001 (cline IOC attestations).
goals.nextAction: Coordinate with INFOSEC + RED: execute DNS flush/Tailscale DNS fix and capture verification outputs; coordinate attestations collection for cline IOC from other hosts/CI.
blockers: Manual sudo required for DNS/Tailscale remediation
